report.summary: The orders service is failing due to Postgres database unavailability, causing 53.32% of POST /orders requests to return 5xx errors
report.likely_cause: Postgres cluster 'orders-db' is in hibernation mode (cnpg.io/hibernation=on)
evidence: orders-db-1 pod readiness probe failed 18 times with HTTP 500
orders service logs show transaction exception: Could not open JPA EntityManager for transaction

suggested_action.detail: Wake up Postgres cluster 'orders-db' by removing the hibernation annotation (cnpg.io/hibernation=off) to restore database availability

rule_verdict.cause: POST /orders is failing: check orders and Postgres
